mi: mi — come! (imperative of the verbs of coming; written m-ꜥ with the walking legs)
tn: tn — this (feminine demonstrative, after its noun; masculine pn)
nn: nn — not (negative particle; nn sḏm·f "will not …", the negative of the future)
bnš: bnš — a part of a door, perhaps the bolt or the jamb (noun; reading and sense not secure; Budge: benś)
n-is: n-is — unless, except (the negation n with the enclitic particle is, written as one group)
tḫ: tḫ — plummet, the weight hanging from the beam of the balance (noun)
bw: bw — place (noun; bw mꜣꜥ "what is right", lit. "the place of right")
·t: ·t — you, your (2nd person feminine singular suffix pronoun; the bread-loaf sign)
ꜥryt: ꜥryt — door-frame, entrance; a part of the doorway, perhaps the lintel or a jamb (noun; Budge: ārit)
imny: imny — right, on the right hand; western (nisba adjective; fem. imnt; written with the emblem of the West)
ḥnk: ḥnk — to present, offer (verb); ḥnkw, ḥnkt "what is presented, offering" (noun)
fꜣt: fꜣt — load, burden, what is carried (noun; from fꜣi "carry, lift")
iꜣby: iꜣby — left, on the left hand; eastern (nisba adjective; fem. iꜣbt; written with the emblem of the East)
gb: gb — Geb, god of the earth (god's name; Budge: Seb)
wn: wn — to open (verb; wn n "open to")
sꜣḥ: sꜣḥ — toe (noun; reading uncertain where it occurs; Budge: saḥ)
pꜣyt: pꜣyt — a part of a door, perhaps a bar or lock (noun; sense not secure; Budge: pait)
wḏꜣt: wḏꜣt — the Sound Eye, the restored eye of Horus (noun; Budge: utchat)
sbk: sbk — Sobek, the crocodile god (god's name; Budge: Sebek)
bꜣḫw: bꜣḫw — Bakhu, the mountain of the sunrise in the east (place name; Budge: Baχau)
iry: iry — one who belongs to, keeper of (nisba of r "to"; iry ꜥꜣ "doorkeeper")
qbt: qbt — a part of the body (?) (noun; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: qebt 'arm')
šw: šw — Shu, god of the air, who holds up the sky (god's name; Budge: Śu)
sꜣ: sꜣ — protection (noun; m sꜣ "for the protection of")
ḥpt: ḥpt — door-post, jamb (?) (noun; plural ḥptw; sense not secure; Budge: ḥeptu)
rnnwtt: rnnwtt — Renenutet, cobra goddess of harvest and nourishment (god's name; Budge: Rennut)
ḫnd: ḫnd — to tread, step (on) (verb; ḫnd ḥr "tread upon")
gr: gr — to be silent (verb); the same signs also write the particle grt "now, moreover"
ḥr-ntt: ḥr-ntt — because (conjunction: ḥr "on account of" + ntt "that")
